dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: #Have you ever taken a dog for a walk, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Yes. Where you stroll together with a canine companion.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Dogs are instinctually loyal. But no matter how well-behaved a dog might be, it gets unhappy if it's cooped up in the same place for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Bringing it outdoors and watching it run free and enjoy itself is a splendid way to relax. It puts you in a good mood.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Don't worry. My staff will be sure to pick out a sufficiently docile dog for you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, I guess I can give it a try.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Alright then. If you have any reservations starting out, we can treat this as a practice area.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Once you've reached the point where you're able to enjoy it, we can head out onto the streets.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Drinking some milk tea and walking the dogs... I wouldn't be surprised if it causes some commotion.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Heh, not that I mind, of course.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Heh, raring to go, I see.
